info.name: CS 313 Week 12 - Shinobi Quiz Battle
info.description: Log in folder runs first, followed by authentication and account checks, then the Week 11 API checks. All protected calls use JWT bearer tokens.

exec: pm.test('duplicate school ID returns 409', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); });

item.name: Register role ADMIN is still PLAYER

exec: pm.test('role spoofing registration returns 201 as PLAYER', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });

item.name: Unknown school ID has same 401 body

exec: pm.test('unknown school ID returns the same 401 response', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json())).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('invalidCredentialsBody')); });
pm.test('/auth/me returns the authenticated user', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

item.name: GET auth me without token returns 401

exec: pm.test('/auth/me without a token returns 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

item.name: GET auth me with tampered token returns 401

exec: pm.test('/auth/me with a tampered token returns 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

item.name: GET auth me with X-Demo-User only returns 401

exec: pm.test('legacy demo-user header is not authentication', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('player cannot list accounts', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('admin can list accounts', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('admin promotes a player', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().user.role).to.eql('HOST'); });

item.name: Admin cannot change their own role

exec: pm.test('admin changing own role returns 409', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); });
pm.test('missing Hub key answers 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

item.name: Create question set - ignores client hostId

exec: pm.test('question set created with 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });

item.name: Another host cannot update question set - 403

exec: pm.test('missing question set answers 404', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); });

item.name: Create a second session for ALREADY_IN_GAME test

exec: pm.test('second session created with 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('new player seat answers 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });

item.name: Player rejoins same session - 200 and same seat/score

exec: pm.test('existing seat can rejoin a RUNNING session with 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

item.name: Player without a seat cannot join RUNNING session - 409

exec: pm.test('new seat in RUNNING session answers 409', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); });

item.name: Player cannot join another RUNNING game - 409 ALREADY_IN_GAME

exec: pm.test('non-owner status change answers 403', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });

item.name: New player cannot join CLOSED session - 409

exec: pm.test('new seat in CLOSED session answers 409', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); });

item.name: Closed session appears in Hub results

exec: pm.test('results answers 200 with Hub key', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

item.name: Cannot delete question set used by a session - 409

exec: pm.test('in-use question set answers 409', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); });
pm.test('disposable set created with 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('delete answers 204 with no body', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(204); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql(''); });

item.name: Full session rejects a new player - 409 SESSION_FULL
item.description: Manual precondition: set up a full session, set capacitySessionCode to its join code, then set capacitySessionReady to true.
